dataset.name: pharos-heldout
dataset.labeling: Second locked test set: Go, Java and TypeScript repositories that no PHAROS benchmark or deployment had indexed, pinned at their branch heads on 2026-10-29. Queries and graded relevance were written by hand from reading the source; labels were checked against parser output only and the file was hashed before any retrieval ran on it. 'behavior' queries paraphrase what the code does without naming identifiers; 'identifier' queries name the API. Grade 2 = the implementation asked about; grade 1 = closely related. Single annotator who also builds the system: run each candidate change against this set once, after tuning on the dev set.

context.approx_tokens_note: chars/4 heuristic, not a tokenizer count
